plan.title: KO vs WT drug response: 2x2 interaction DE + GSEA
plan.analytical_narrative:
The research question — does the drug act differently in the knockout than in the wild type — is a genotype x treatment interaction on a 2x2 factorial bulk RNA-seq design: 16 heart samples (metadata.csv, 16 x 4), 4 per cell (WT/vehicle, WT/drug, KO/vehicle, KO/drug), gene-level raw Salmon counts for 12,000 gene symbols across 17 columns (gene symbol + 16 samples) in counts.csv. Every script is Python, per the user constraint; PyDESeq2 0.5.4 replaces the R DESeq2 stack and gseapy 1.3.1 replaces fgsea.

T1S1 establishes sample structure before any test: blind VST, PCA on the 500 most variable genes coloured by genotype and by treatment, a sample-distance heatmap and library sizes. With no batch column in the 4-column metadata, the QC is the only check that a cell of the design does not sit apart for a technical reason; the counts column count (17) is one more than the sample count (16) because the first column is the gene symbol, and the QC step must confirm the 16 count columns match the 16 metadata rows one to one before anything downstream runs.

T1S2 is the inferential core. Minimal pre-filter (>=10 counts in at least 4 samples, the smallest cell size), median-of-ratios size factors estimated inside the model — the counts are never pre-scaled — and the design ~ genotype + treatment + genotype:treatment with WT and vehicle set explicitly as reference levels. The Wald test on the interaction coefficient answers the question directly; the two simple treatment effects (drug vs vehicle within WT, drug vs vehicle within KO) are reported beside it, because the interaction coefficient alone says nothing about whether the drug does anything in either genotype. LFCs are shrunk with ashr (the KO simple effect is a sum of coefficients, not a single coefficient, so apeglm does not apply to it), BH adjustment at alpha 0.05 with independent filtering is applied within each contrast, and the p-value histogram of each contrast is inspected before the adjustment is trusted.

The honest limit is power: an interaction coefficient is a difference of differences with a standard error roughly double that of a main effect, and 4 replicates per cell is at the low end. The plan states up front that few or zero genes may pass FDR on the interaction contrast, that this is not evidence the drug acts identically in the two genotypes, and that the interaction must not be replaced by a 'significant in KO but not in WT' comparison of two separate gene lists — which is a different and invalid claim.

T2S1 carries the interpretation to gene sets. Because a short significant list has no power in an over-representation test, enrichment is preranked GSEA (gseapy) on the full list of tested genes ranked by the DESeq2 Wald statistic — the stated choice on a disputed point, taken because the Wald statistic scales the effect by its uncertainty and does not saturate into ties. It is run once per contrast, never pooled, against human Hallmark first (50 sets, MSigDB 2026.1) then Reactome or, if no Reactome GMT is staged, the human WikiPathways collection and human GO BP, each collection tested separately with its release named. Symbols are already HGNC, matching all human GMTs, so no ID conversion is needed; the unmapped share is still reported.

T1S3 assembles the report: the three results side by side per gene with the reference levels named, the unshrunken and shrunken LFC with lfcSE, the MA and dispersion diagnostics, the count of NA p-values from the Cook's-distance outlier flag reported apart from those the independent filter removed (in a 4-replicate cell DESeq2 flags rather than replaces outliers), the leading-edge genes of each significant set, and the reproducibility record with seeds and collection versions.

steps.name: Interaction report and reproducibility record
steps.question: Taken together, is there evidence that the drug acts differently in KO than in WT hearts, and how strong is that evidence given 4 replicates per cell?
steps.description: Assemble the final report. For every gene, present the three results side by side: drug-vs-vehicle within WT (reference genotype), drug-vs-vehicle within KO, and the interaction contrast — with both reference levels named beside the table. Give the unshrunken log2FoldChange, the ashr-shrunken log2FoldChange and lfcSE per contrast, ranking genes and drawing all plots on the shrunken value. Include the MA plot and the dispersion plot from the PyDESeq2 fit, the p-value histograms, a volcano of the interaction contrast, and per-cell normalized count plots for the top interaction genes. Summarise the GSEA results per contrast with leading-edge genes and mark leading-edge overlap between reported sets. State the design formula, thresholds, number of tested genes, number of DE genes per contrast, package versions, seeds and gene set collection releases.
steps.context: The reader's question is a yes/no about differential drug action in the knockout. The report must not answer it by comparing two separate significant-gene lists; the interaction contrast is the only test of that claim, and its power at n=4 per cell is limited. Where the interaction is null, the report should say the study cannot resolve a genotype-dependent drug effect of the size the data supports detecting, and give the observed effect sizes rather than a bare negative.
acceptance_criteria: A merged per-gene table with the WT simple effect, the KO simple effect and the interaction contrast side by side, each labelled with its contrast and with the reference levels (WT, vehicle) named
Unshrunken log2FoldChange, ashr-shrunken log2FoldChange and lfcSE present per contrast; all ranking and plotting done on the shrunken value
MA plot and dispersion plot from the fit included before the gene tables, with a sentence on what each shows
Volcano of the interaction contrast plus per-cell normalized-count panels for the top interaction genes
GSEA summary per contrast with leading-edge genes and marked leading-edge overlap between reported sets
Reproducibility record: design formula, thresholds, n tested, n DE per contrast, package versions, permutation seed, gene set collection releases

An explicit statement of the power limitation of the interaction test at n=4 per cell, and an explicit statement that a difference in significance between the two simple effects is not the interaction
constraints: Report the interaction contrast and both simple effects together — never the interaction coefficient alone and never a simple effect alone
Name the reference level of each factor beside every table
Rank genes and draw plots on the shrunken log2 fold change; keep the p-values from the unshrunken fit
State that enrichment results are method-dependent and are hypotheses for follow-up
Python only for all figures and tables
caveats: Do not present a gene as showing a genotype-dependent drug effect on the strength of the simple effects alone
A null interaction at this sample size is not evidence of equivalence; report it as inconclusive with the effect sizes shown
Only one differential expression method is run here, so no two-method overlap robustness set is available — say so rather than implying one was checked

R-0042 two-method overlap is not planned — a single DESeq2 path is run and the step states that.
